summary: Build per-larva and group-average functional connectivity (FC) matrices from zebrafish whole-brain calcium imaging, by Gaussian-smoothing region-averaged ΔF/F₀ traces and computing Pearson correlations between brain regions.
use_when: Run the Group-average functional connectivity from regional calcium traces recipe

Build per-larva and group-average functional connectivity (FC) matrices from zebrafish whole-brain calcium imaging, by Gaussian-smoothing region-averaged ΔF/F₀ traces and computing Pearson correlations between brain regions.
Generate the outputs described by ns_ana-zebrafish-ca-pearson-fc_matrix
avoid_when: The intended conclusion requires causal inference from an observational association alone
Connectivity estimates are unsupported because sampling, preprocessing, or matrix alignment is inadequate
